{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check how many unique patients there are
print(f'Unique patient_id count: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
print('\nHighest sample_seq per patient:')
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts().sort_index()
print(df_grouped)"}
